rationale: Post-hoc review of an applied service-restoration migration (2026-07-29 ruling: review here is after the fact by design). Migration 558 restores tool-generator save_tool's adopt_existing_page=true, which migration 435 (bugs_open/286, live since 2026-08-16) set and an UN-SNAPSHOTTED write removed between 516's apply (~16:55Z 2026-08-21) and 08:36:05Z 2026-08-22 — no agent_definitions_backup row, no schema_migrations row, writer unidentified. While absent, every adopt-route add_tool fleet-wide died at save_tool with pages_site_id_name_key 23505 and the work item read complete with error NULL; measured casualty one item (21ab0704, tool-blueprint-compiler, the first adopt build attempted after the window opened). The binary was probed (positive + negative control) and still carries the adopt path, so config restore was the whole fix; the refiled build then adopted cleanly and is serve-graded live. The restore was applied before this submission because the lane's Phase C programme (and any other lane's tool rebuild) was dead while the key was absent — the 336 precedent: restore service, then review.
